title: health check api returns server status and timestamp
description: Test the GET /api/health endpoint to verify it returns a 200 status with a JSON body containing status, message, and timestamp fields indicating the server is running.

title: authentication login returns token and user on valid credentials
description: Test the POST /api/auth/login endpoint with valid username and password to ensure it returns a 200 status with a JWT token and user object containing id, username, fullName, and role.

title: authentication me returns user for valid token
description: Test the GET /api/auth/me endpoint with a valid Authorization Bearer token to verify it returns a 200 status with the authenticated user object.

title: authentication logout acknowledges logout with message
description: Test the POST /api/auth/logout endpoint with a valid Authorization Bearer token to ensure it returns a 200 status with a confirmation message acknowledging logout.

title: user management list users requires admin authorization
description: Test the GET /api/users endpoint with an admin token to verify it returns a 200 status with a list of users excluding password hashes, and test with no or non-admin token to verify 401 or 403 errors.

title: user management create user with admin authorization
description: Test the POST /api/users endpoint with valid admin token and user data to create a new user, expecting a 201 status with the created user object, and test error cases like duplicate username and non-admin access.

title: user management update user fields with admin authorization
description: Test the PUT /api/users/:id endpoint with admin token and valid update fields (fullName, role, password) to update a user, expecting a 200 status with updated user, and test error cases like no fields to update and user not found.

title: user management activate deactivate user account with admin authorization
description: Test the PATCH /api/users/:id/status endpoint with admin token to activate or deactivate a user account, ensuring it returns 200 with updated user, and test error case where admin tries to deactivate own account resulting in 400 error.
